tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Kalyan Raavi
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in joining your team. With over 5 years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep backend expertise in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs and Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and managed platform administration through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC) and Backoffice.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed while supporting production troubleshooting.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 (earliest start date 16.12.2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background matches your needs.

tailoring.why_company: I am keen to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience to your projects, building scalable backend services and robust e-commerce architectures using Java, Spring, and enterprise integration patterns.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring experience to support your e-commerce initiatives.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Kalyan, I saw your posting and am very interested. With 5+ years in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring at Rockwell and Shell, I believe my background aligns well. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Kalyan Raavi - SAP Commerce Cloud Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the opening. With over 5 years of backend development experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and enterprise integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical capabilities to your team.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
